//: The --noEmit TYPECHECK project. Two notes. (1) Unlike the kit's, it needs no `paths` for `pg-prime`: this package imports nothing from the workspace at all (design/13 decision 7 — zero dependencies), it only WRITES text that names them. (2) `types: ["node"]` is explicit because the automatic `@types` sweep does not reach `@types/node` here: the other packages get the Node globals transitively, through the `@types/pg` their own dependencies pull in, and this one depends on nothing — without the line every `node:` import is a TS2591 and `NodeJS.WritableStream` is a TS2503. `src/versions.ts` is generated by `scripts/versions.mjs`, which `typecheck`, `build` and the vitest global setup each run first; it is git-ignored and never committed (design/13 §3 X).
